## The Clean Energy Workforce Challenge

Policy support and climate commitments have increased investment in renewable energy, and employers in the sector commonly report difficulty finding enough skilled workers. We quote no workforce forecasts or salary figures here, because we have not cited a source for any. Use a named, dated source for your market.

### Key Roles in Clean Energy

| Role | Sector | Skills |
|---|---|---|
| Solar installation technician | Solar | Electrical, roofing, safety |
| Wind turbine technician | Wind | Mechanical, electrical, working at heights |
| Energy storage engineer | Battery and storage | Chemical engineering, power systems |
| Grid integration specialist | Utilities | Power systems, SCADA, regulation |
| Sustainability manager | Cross-sector | Carbon accounting, ESG reporting |
| Clean energy project manager | Cross-sector | Project management, permitting, finance |
| Business development lead | Developer | Origination, PPA negotiation, market analysis |

### Sourcing Strategies

**Oil and gas transition.** Many skills transfer from fossil fuels to renewables:

- Drilling engineers to geothermal
- Pipeline engineers to hydrogen infrastructure
- Offshore workers to offshore wind
- Safety professionals across sectors

**Want to talk through your hiring plan?**

[Send us a message](/contact)

**Military veterans.** Training programs for transitioning service members exist in the sector. Check current program details with the program operator.

**Trade schools.** Electrical and mechanical trade programs have been adding renewable energy content.

**STEM graduates.** Environmental science, engineering and chemistry programs produce clean energy candidates.

### The Mission Advantage

Clean energy employers can use mission as a hiring advantage. Candidates who care about environmental impact may weigh it when choosing an employer. We do not claim how much it affects acceptance or pay, so do not assume candidates will take less for mission-aligned work.

### Compensation

Pay in the sector can move quickly as it matures. Benchmark against a current, named source for each role and location before you make offers.

### Building Your Clean Energy Team

- Start with project management and technical leads
- Hire installation and field technicians
- Add business development and finance
- Scale operations and maintenance teams
- Build corporate functions such as HR, legal and marketing
